mechanism: A scale-mismatch challenge stays coherent when one shared token remains visible across control, obstruction, route change and an attempt toward a fixed target. Court or arena markings must preserve geography, and the ending may show reaction or suspense without claiming a result that is not visibly confirmed.

invariants.rule: Establish two clearly different scales, one shared token and one fixed target in the same arena.
invariants.ablation_failure: Hiding any one element reduces the scene to unrelated spectacle.

invariants.rule: Use repeated token control to prove who currently owns the action.
invariants.ablation_failure: A disappearing token breaks the causal chain.

invariants.rule: Let the larger body obstruct space while the smaller body changes route rather than matching size.
invariants.ablation_failure: Equalized movement makes the size contrast cosmetic.

invariants.rule: Show one readable token trajectory toward the fixed target.
invariants.purpose: Converts maneuvering into a clear attempt.
invariants.ablation_failure: A cut directly to reaction hides the challenge's decisive action.

invariants.rule: End on a visible shared reaction state and only claim success if the target result is directly shown.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unsupported score claim invents the payoff.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

instantiations.concept: On a tabletop magnetic arena, a coin-sized delivery robot controls one glowing bead while a giant inflatable gatekeeper sweeps broad sectors. The robot changes lanes and launches the bead toward a suspended copper ring; the ending holds both reactions and the ring, without declaring success unless the bead visibly passes through.
